# Compatibility reference

`sources/animation_bind.json` contains GTA skeleton bind transforms derived from `tools/BoneProperties.xml` in [Sollumz](https://github.com/Sollumz/Sollumz), by Skylumz, Colton Fox and alexguirre. This reference data is provided under GPL-3.0; see `Sollumz_LICENSE.txt`. The complete archive includes the reference data and the animation generator.

The meshes, material maps, ornament geometry, motion paths, scripts and documentation in this task were authored locally. No weapon mesh or texture from a donor GTA addon is distributed. CodeWalker.Core is an external build dependency, not bundled software; its upstream notices apply when obtaining it.
